final_message:
All 3 tests pass.

Implementation:

- **`diffLines`** — forward greedy algorithm using a precomputed LCS suffix-length table (`dp[i][j]` = LCS length of `a[i:]` and `b[j:]`). At each step, if `a[i] === b[j]`, keep and advance both; else delete `a[i]` if `dp[i+1][j] >= dp[i][j]` (doesn't shrink the LCS), otherwise insert `b[j]`. This builds the edit script from the front, matching the tie-breaking rule.
- **`renderDiff`** — maps ops to `"  line"`, `"- line"`, `"+ line"`, joined by `\n`.
- **`diffStats`** — counts `kept`, `deleted`, `added` across the ops array.
